Je veux rétablir mon service internet suspendu

User Guide: Speak only in French Canadian. Say 'Mon service est suspendu, je veux le rétablir.' Authenticate, pay the balance, and confirm restoration If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
